nom: SUNDAY RILEY U.F.O. Ultra-Clarifying Acne Treatment Face Oil

avis.texte: After getting back home from traveling out of the country earlier this year, my skin was really bad. I was breaking out a lot from eating food I shouldn't have, plus the stress of travel etc. Very bad timing because my bf's family were all coming to town for this big event and I was embarrassed at the state of my skin. I found out about this product on some skincare reddit page and went out and bought it. It cleared my skin and totally saved me right before all the family events. Now is a part of my daily skincare routine. My skin isn't 100% perfect, but I feel like there's a product in my arsenal that I can actually rely on to keep my acne under control which is amazing. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: For Acne but has Acne Causing Ingredients? Why?
avis.texte: Has Linseed and Apricot oil which are both level 5 Acne causing ingredients so while this may help some faces those who are truly acne prone will have issues.
I love this for nightly use. Helps with break outs and keeping acne to a minimum. I repurchased!

I developed horrid acne in my mid 20s, but this product SAVED MY SKIN literally overnight! I told myself if i spent the money and it sucked, I'd of course return it and try other things. Well rip to my wallet. honestly, ive never been happier to say that. The only other thing I love this much is my mom, and my dog.
Not necessarily a horrible product however if you are looking to treat acne I would spend your money elsewhere.

avis.titre: Best skincare product for oily/acne prone skin!
avis.texte: I was suffering from constant recurring acne/blemishes and stubborn blackheads for awhile, but this product has done a miracle for my skin, it's been 2 weeks now and my acne is gone, blackheads are finally disappearing, acne scars are gone/some still in fading process and my face feels super soft/smooth like never before, I cannot stress enough how much I recommended this product, best purchase I've ever made!
works amazing for white heads and black heads. been using for 4 years!

I ended up returning this product unfortunately. I heard really good things about this brand and product but It just made my acne worse. I used it moderately as what I do for any skin care product I am trying to incorporate in my routine but even then the product was just making my acne worse and only a few weeks passed when I had started to use the product. I've never got such bad acne until I started using it. And yes the scent is strong and it does stink! Even when you use a very tiny amount, you can still smell it. It's a strong odor.

avis.titre: Best Product I've Found For Adult Acne
avis.texte: I am in my 30's and have struggled with cystic hormonal jawline acne and blackheads in the last 5 years. I have tried so many expensive products, supplements, facial treatments, masques etc. nothing seemed to make much of a difference. It took me about two months to see it entirely clear, but I don't even notice breakouts on my cycle anymore and my blackheads haven't been this clear in years. It smells kind of weird but doesn't dry out my sensitive skin at all and I use it daily! Highly recommend!

I am 60 yo and still have adult onset acne.The UFO works every time for me.I will never use anything else.While the same product does not work for everyone,this product is definitely worth a try.I love it.
Almost done using the bottle . Did nothing but broke me out even more.

Did nothing for my acne. May have made acne and blackheads worse. Stopped using this - changing nothing else in my routine - and skin instantly improved. I love the Good Genes and CEO Glow. Sadly, UFO did not work for my cystic acne prone skin.
Decongestant for Skin! UFO cleared up my cystic breakout within a few days and is keeping my complexion clear and smooth.

avis.titre: Did a great job on my pores

After about 4 weeks, I noticed my blackheads were going away and my pores appeared to shrink (because they weren't filling with oil). I will keep using it and have already repurchased.
Amazing product, works on blemishes as well as just making my skin radiant, i do mix it with my moisturizer.

I love using this oil, especially during my time of the month where I break out a lot. I have sensitive skin and this does not clog up my skin. I mostly use it in my evening skincare routine, before my moisturiser, and allow it to do its magic on my skin overnight. Remember to be consistent with it!

This wirks incredibly well. I noticed a difference in my skin the first time i used it. I dont have horrible acne, but it's noticeable, and i have seen is clear up quickly and it helps wity acne scars. One of my best things about this product is that it doesnt dry out the skin. I have super dry skin and some acne products can be drying. If youre looking for an acne serum that actually works, look no further. Its green and looks interesting to apply to the skin and it does have a strange smell. It always smells like grass and or corn chips, but i dont mind it. The only tiny little con is that sometimes when i apply it to my face, it accidentally gets near my eyes and stings. So avoid contact with eyes. But its great otherwise!

avis.titre: Ok hear me out.. WORTH IT. But that's not all..
avis.texte: So typically I never leave reviews, but this stuff is worth it. I've seen results, while the smell is rather unpleasant, I still feel it's worth the end result!
Nope. I don't want to even bother trying this because it smells bad.
It really helps to dry and help the acne . I really recommend it .

avis.titre: BLAST THROUGH BLEMISHES & BREAKOUTS AT WARP SPEED
avis.texte: I've always been curious as to why the U.F.O. Facial Oil never really got the buzz as say LUNA or even JUNO. Nonetheless, it's been a STAPLE in my skincare regimen for QUITE some time (years in fact.) For context, when I started to take skincare a bit more seriously six years ago, a prominent skincare YouTuber actually introduced me to the Sunday Riley brand. I decided to splurge on several products, U.F.O. being one of them. I was hesitant because I have acne prone skin and had NEVER used oils on my face prior. Well, all I can say is - if there was ONE Sunday Riley product I had to have, it was the U.F.O. It does such an amazing job preventing breakouts, blackheads, soothing my skin after shaving (I'm a guy), and clarifying the skin. It's lightweight, has a bearable smell, and absorbs fairly quickly. I always get the larger bottle and even using it twice daily (am and pm) the bottle lasts a GOOD six months, so I feel it's well worth the money. If you have acne prone skin and are looking to treat and/or prevent breakouts, I say try the U.F.O. Facial Oil. You just may end up as surprised as I was. Note that a LITTLE goes a long way. I apply six drops MAX on my face (2 drops to my cheeks and forehead). Most of the time, I just apply 2 drops to each cheek area because that's where I'm most likely to breakout first due to shaving and oil production. Saturn + Martian + U.F.O. was my ultimate acne fighting trio but unfortunately I had to switch toners as the Martian was a bit too s
This product has clean ingredients and my acne started to clear in two days. However, my allergies were so bad that I finally had to wash it off and take Benadryl.

I really loved the way this looked & felt on my skin. I wanted to keep using it but i think i just have really sensitive skin bc i kept waking up to red patches on my right side after using it the night before so i had to stop using it. I really liked it besides that , it made my skin glow , made my pores look smaller but my skin is just more on the sensitive side to whatever ingredient caused it 🥲

1. If you're not giving it 30 days, you don't see its full benefits. I have combo/oily/sensitive skin. On my face this is the first product I use when I see I'm going to have a break out. 2. When you use new products to takes time for the skin to clear congestion and clear out. 3!!! After both pregnancies I got horrible rough and bumpy arms and it spread to my legs and back and this literally cleared me up in two months using it once a week on those places. I've tried all the other body products under the moon for it. The main ingredient wasn't enough in other products for my problem til I gave this product a try. Since I was already using it for my face I figured why not. Best decision ever so now I use it only for break outs. I wish I had before and after photos.

I wash my face at nightly with Murad AHA/BHA cleanser, apply Kate Sometville Total Repair overnight. I apply this in the AM, after i wash my face. Use it under my makeup and wow I am amazed at how smooth my skin looks. Sometimes you just have to mix things up and see what works!

This product did wonders for clearing up my congested pores between my eyebrows. I have always been prone to breakouts between my brows, and my pores in that area are always congested. This product is the only thing that has ever consistently cleared up my congested pores and persistent brow acne. It is pricier than I would usually pay for a skincare product, but a little goes a long way and the bottle lasts me a long time, so it has been worth the splurge to clear my persistent acne. I've also found this oil to be very gentle on my skin. It isn't as drying and doesn't cause irritation or redness the way other salicylic acid products typically do.

This is my 3rd bottle of U.F.O. facial oil. My skin loves this oil! This oil helps with my hormonal acne from overreacting. I love that this formula is a dry oil so it absorbs quickly. I highly recommend this product.

GIFTED by Sunday Riley I don't feel I can give a full comprehensive review as unfortunately have been unwell with a bad chest infection at the same time Mother Nature called which has caused my skin flare up anyways. However the packaging of the product is lovely very luxurious. The smell is okay took some getting used to at first. The texture of the product is lovely and it soaked into my skin lovely. I did only use it on an evening so unsure how it would be under make up.

Sunday Riley gifted me an excellent facial oil. The oil was a lifesaver as i had just come back from travelling and my skin was rough, textured and pimply. The oil got rid of the texture and minimised the appearance of pores and pimples. However, the only flaw is it's pungent smell which is bad for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great as part of night routine
avis.texte: My U.F.O was gifted by SundayRiley, I used the review for two weeks, usually as part of my night routine (ad hoc use in the mornings). Overall results were good, I had two pimples at the start of use and they have healed with no black marks. avis.titre: Absolute game-changer for my acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I currently testing the U.F.O. ULTRA-CLARIFYING ACNE TREATMENT FACE OIL, gifted by Sunday Riley, and it has been an absolute game-changer for my acne-prone skin. This potent potion lives up to its name, significantly reducing the amount of pesky acne on my face. Thanks to this product, my skin has taken on a brighter and more radiant appearance, which I absolutely love! One of the most impressive things about this face oil is its effectiveness in tackling congested pores and blackheads. While it hasn't completely eradicated them, I can see a visible improvement. My complexion feels smoother and less clogged, which is a significant win considering the constant battle I used to face. I have learned to use this product sparingly, as daily application can cause some irritation. But the key here is finding the right balance, and when used judiciously, I enjoy all the incredible benefits without the unwanted redness or discomfort. Sunday Riley's U.F.O. ULTRA-CLARIFYING ACNE TREATMENT FACE OIL has undeniably earned its place in my skincare routine. It has significantly improved my acne situation and brought a healthy glow to my complexion. While it may not be a perfect solution for congested pores and blackheads, its overall impact on my skin makes it a must-have in my beauty arsenal. Thank you, Sunday Riley, for creating such a powerful skincare gem that has made a significant difference in my acne-prone skin journey.

This item was gifted by Sunday Riley to me in exchange for an honest review. I love this product! Sunday Riley UFO serum is very lightweight and a small amount of product goes a very long way in maintaining a bright and rejuvenated complexion. It has a lovely scent, which is not overpowering. I have found with a few weeks use my skin is completely changed - I'm noticing less blemishes and people are often commenting on a new radiance and glow that I now have. I find my dark spots and congestion are both much improved since use.

I have been using the Sunday Riley U.F.O. Ultra Clarifying Treatment Face Oil for 2 weeks now, and I must say, it has been a game-changer for my dry skin with clogged pores! As someone who has struggled with dullness, dark spots, and stubborn blackheads, this product delivered impressive results that left me pleasantly surprised. First and foremost, the face oil deeply nourished my parched skin, providing a much-needed boost of hydration that lasted throughout the day. It didn't feel greasy or heavy, which was a relief, as I often worry about using oils on my already dry skin. The lightweight texture allowed it to absorb quickly, leaving my skin feeling supple and soft. The most remarkable transformation was in the brightness of my complexion. After consistent use, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's radiance. Those pesky dark spots that had been bothering me for ages gradually faded, making my skin look more even-toned and youthful. Furthermore, the face oil worked wonders on my stubborn blackheads. It seemed to unclog my pores and prevent new blackheads from forming, leaving my skin smoother and clearer over time. However, the one drawback I encountered was the overwhelming smell of the product. The strong fragrance lingered for quite some time, which may not sit well with those sensitive to scents. Despite this downside, the excellent results on my skin made me willing to overlook the fragrance issue. In conclusion, I am genuinely grateful that U.F.O. Ultra Cl

this is the best product i've tried this is the only product that has actually worked for my skin i can't recommend this enough i started seeing visible results about 7 days after i started using this product gifted by sunday riley

Gifted by sundayriley [I got this product to test] The consistency of the product is oily but it spreads very nicely on the skin. Dosing with a pipette, which is very convenient and efficient, the smell is quite intense, but pleasant for me.

This product has been a game-changer for my acne-prone skin. The combination of salicylic acid, tea tree oil, and black cumin seed oil has worked wonders in clearing up my breakouts and preventing new ones from forming. Not only does this face oil effectively target acne, but it also provides much-needed hydration to my skin. I love how lightweight and non-greasy it feels upon application. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft and nourished. Since incorporating the U.FO. Face Oil into my skincare routine, I have noticed a significant improvement in the overall clarity and texture of my skin. I was gifted by sundayriley to try out the U.F.O. Ultra-Clarifying Treatment Face Oil, and I must say, it has become a game-changer in my skincare routine. As someone with blemish-prone skin, finding the right face oil can be quite challenging, but U.F.O. has truly impressed me. First and foremost, the formula is incredibly lightweight, which is perfect for my oily skin. It absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy residue behind. Within minutes, my face feels nourished and hydrated, without feeling weighed down or shiny. This oil has never caused any breakouts or clogged pores, which is a huge plus for me. The key ingredient in this face oil is 1.5% salicylic acid, which is known for its acne-fighting properties. It helps to unclog pores, reduce inflammation, and keep my skin clear and smooth. Furthermore, the Ultra-Clarifying Treatment Face Oil contains other beneficial ingredients like tea tree oil and black cumin seed oil, which work together to soothe the skin and provide antioxidant protection. I apply it on cleansed skin in the morning and eve

(not an ad, gifted by sundayriley)
